description: keyd runs with '[ids] 0627:0001' (the VM keyboard's vendor:product) and '[main] f9 = f12': keyd grabs the QEMU keyboard, so F9 is redirected to F12 and Hyprland's F12 bind fires. whykey inspects F9 without a captured device, so it cannot know the key comes from a listed device: it answers handled-uncertain (tolerated, PASS~) and names the F9 to F12 remap, without following it to F12
